# TeXTech 3.0.0 RC 1

TeXTech 3.0 is the public relaunch of the project formerly known as
AdvanceDataMonitor. This release candidate combines AE2 monitoring, data
weaving, the WebAE console, planning and automation, optional AI/voice
integration, and immersive utility systems for Minecraft 1.7.10 / GTNH.

This is a **pre-release** for compatibility and upgrade testing. `v2.0.0`
remains the latest stable release during the RC observation period.

## Downloads

| Asset | Purpose | Install location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `textech-@TAG@.jar` | Main TeXTech mod | Instance or server `mods/` |
| `textech-@TAG@-voice.jar` | Optional offline voice model and marker mod | `mods/`, beside the main JAR |
| `textech-@TAG@-webae.zip` | Optional standalone WebAE static bundle | Extract into the Minecraft instance root |
| `textech-@TAG@-sources.jar` | Developer source attachment | IDE / development use only |

The voice JAR is optional; the main mod must continue to start without it.
WebAE is disabled by default. Treat WebAE tokens as administrator credentials,
bind the service to a trusted interface, and never publish tokens in logs,
screenshots, Issues, or configuration examples.

## Compatibility and upgrade notes

- Minecraft `1.7.10`
- Forge `10.13.4.1614`
- Target line: GTNH `2.9.0-beta-2` and newer compatible 2.9.x builds
- Back up worlds and configuration before moving from `v2.0.0`.
- Stop the client/server, replace the main JAR, add or replace optional assets,
  then review the generated configuration before exposing WebAE.

## RC limitations

- The RC still requires client and dedicated-server smoke testing across the
  full GTNH compatibility matrix before promotion to `v3.0.0`.
- Optional MCEF, AI providers, voice capture, QQ/AstrBot, Dynmap/JourneyMap,
  and other bridges require their own dependencies and configuration.
- Card Battle remains a separate project; this repository contains only its
  documented bridge boundary.

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ImgoodWK/TeXTech-GTNH/blob/@TAG@/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete high-level change summary and the bilingual documentation
portal for installation and operator guidance.

## Integrity and provenance

- Release commit: `@COMMIT_SHA@`
- Provenance ID: `@PROVENANCE_ID@`
- Immutable tag: `@TAG@`

Verify checksums after downloading all assets:

```bash
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
```

Verify GitHub's artifact attestation for an individual asset:

```bash
gh attestation verify textech-@TAG@.jar --repo ImgoodWK/TeXTech-GTNH
```

The tag and uploaded assets are immutable. If this RC needs correction, the
original release will be retained and a new `v3.0.0-rc.2` tag will be issued.
